coverage_override.reason: The inherent hand summon and the Tuner-changing Ignition Effect are two effects; the each-effect HOPT applies separately to both.

effects.printed_clause: If you control a Level 3 or lower Zombie monster, you can Special Summon this card from your hand. Each-effect HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: An uncopyable hand EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC requires an open zone and a face-up controlled Level 3-or-lower Zombie. An oath count keyed to the card id now limits this procedure across copies once per turn.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses an inherent hand Special Summon procedure with a once-per-turn summon/effect limitation.

effects.issue: Fixed: added the missing hard once-per-turn count limit to the inherent self-Summon procedure.

effects.printed_clause: If you control no Tuner monsters: send 1 card from your hand to the GY; this card is treated as a Tuner until the End Phase. Each-effect HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: An id-keyed Ignition Effect checks that no face-up controlled Tuner exists, sends an eligible hand card as cost, and gives the related face-up handler TYPE_TUNER with standard and End Phase resets.

official_references.matched_structure: A Zombie Ignition Effect changes Tuner-related properties after a hand/Deck cost with a turn-bounded reset.
